comparison_scope.purpose: Compare reversible system arrangements before any site, route, capacity or operating decision.
selection_rule: hard gates before efficiency or convenience
ordinary public and accessible routes remain visible
protect the slowest or most exposed group rather than the average
prefer a reversible ground-first handoff with a named receiver
return to HOLD when local evidence, consent or responsibility is missing

scale_chain.review: three key-area connections and external boundary
station, curb, community and enterprise interface relationships
ordinary route, staffed node and protected conflict zone
handoff, appeal, pause and withdrawal detail

spatial_moves: let demand compete for the same curb
treat public crossings as residual space

hard_gate_results.reason: ordinary public and accessible route is not protected
no receiver or maintenance owner
no dated readback denominator
no safe human takeover
protected-group harm cannot be isolated

alternatives.decision_basis: Reject because the system externalizes peak conflict to public space before a safe ordinary route exists.

alternatives.label_zh: S1 地面优先多方式协同
spatial_moves: place a staffed handoff at each key area
use time-windowed curb states with a visible withdrawal path

hard_gate_results.reason: public, accessible and staffed routes are required before any feeder
each node requires a receiving and maintenance role
each state change has a group boundary and public receipt
outage, weather and missed-transfer paths return to ground service
care, accessibility, night and ordinary users are separately read back

alternatives.decision_basis: Advance only to professional design review because it preserves the public baseline, keeps the feeder reversible and makes the failure path spatially visible.

spatial_moves: keep a protected evacuation and accessible route
treat weather cancellation as the default design case

hard_gate_results.reason: air-first logic risks making ground service residual
operator, insurance and emergency receiver are unknown
weather, noise and transfer evidence are unavailable
cancellation must return to ordinary ground service
accessibility and privacy effects need independent review

alternatives.decision_basis: Revise into a conditional add-on; do not let a speculative air layer displace the ground public baseline.

alternatives.label_zh: S3 极端天气地面回退
spatial_moves: mark a dry and accessible fallback loop
move the curb to human-only or emergency states
publish a paper and telephone withdrawal notice

hard_gate_results.reason: ground public and staffed routes remain the baseline
weather-shift receiver and maintenance roster are unknown
no local weather or route-observation series is supplied
the design returns to rail, bus, human and paper routes
care, wheelchair and night return must be separately read back

alternatives.decision_basis: Revise as the default resilience layer around S1, not as a separate operating promise or weather-performance claim.

rights_contract.minimum: public route remains visible and usable without an AI account
rights_contract.failure_action: freeze feeder and return to public or staffed route

rights_contract.minimum: a comparable accessible route and caregiver pause remain available
rights_contract.failure_action: stop the affected option and record a human alternative

rights_contract.minimum: feeder, loading and event demand cannot displace public interchange
rights_contract.failure_action: remove feeder demand and keep the public crossing

rights_contract.minimum: a person can appeal, cancel, pause and receive a dated status
rights_contract.failure_action: hold the state and return to the last safe receipt

rights_contract.minimum: grouped demand only; no continuous personal trace is required for basic service
rights_contract.failure_action: delete the proposed booking and keep the offline route

selection_reason: keeps conditional air and weather logic subordinate to ground fallback
makes five rights and five scales reviewable
next_review_inputs: independent accessibility, fire, privacy and transport review
review_readout.publication_boundary: This readout is a conceptual comparison, not a construction, permit, capacity, performance, ranking or implementation decision.
